rootCauseV37.priorLowCoverage: Scan-window refresh (pageSize×maxPages≈500) against deep catalogs (e.g. totalCount 82k) + refresh checkpoint not restored between runs (always startedOffset=1).
rootCauseV37.fix: Documented shoppingProducts(productIds) targeted refresh + durable refresh-coverage checkpoint restore/persist.

coverageReconcile.note: sourceMatched=raw productIds first-pass; successfullyRefreshed includes V38 recoveries; cumulative updated post-reverify.

displayClass.note: CURRENT=SOURCE_FRESH only (authoritative sourceUpdatedAt). UNKNOWN must never be presented as CURRENT. Fetch time ≠ source time.

verificationClass.note: VERIFIED_RECENT=successful fetch/refresh within policy window (not inventable as CURRENT). SOURCE_CURRENT requires CJ sourceUpdatedAt.

layerLossAudit.note: Compare rejectReasons + mainButtonSectionFillCount. Legitimate expiry reduces counts; section fill recovers main-button partner offers.
